venue.name: Gopal Tent House
venue.description: Grand shamianas, handcrafted mandaps and themed decor — hosting unforgettable weddings in Kanpur.

mission: For three generations, Gopal Tent House has raised tents and lit grounds for the families of Kanpur. We believe a wedding is not a transaction — it is a promise made in front of everyone a family loves. Our work is to make sure nothing on that day goes wrong: the canopy holds, the food arrives hot, the lights come on when the baraat turns the corner. Everything else is yours to enjoy.

testimonials.content: We had 800 guests and not one thing went wrong. The whole ground was themed in blue and white exactly as we asked, and the team handled the baraat, the catering and a sudden drizzle without us ever hearing about it.

testimonials.name: Meera Agarwal
testimonials.content: I have attended weddings at Gopal Tent House for twenty years, so booking my own daughter's was an easy decision. Gopal ji personally checked every arrangement the night before.

about.title: Three Generations of Weddings
about.content: Gopal Tent House began in 1992 with a single hand-stitched shamiana and a borrowed truck. Today we run a 25,000 sq ft ground, an in-house kitchen and a crew of over forty — but the job has not changed. We put up the tent, we light the ground, and we make sure a family can stand in the middle of their own wedding without worrying about a single thing.
about.story: Everything is handled under one roof: the ground, the tent, the decor, the mandap, the food, the lights and the furniture. Families deal with one team and one bill instead of chasing six vendors. That is why most of our bookings still come from someone who attended a wedding here and asked for our number.
values: One team, one bill, no chasing vendors
Pure vegetarian kitchen, cooked on site
Setup finished a full day before the event
